I noticed recently that it had been more than a year since I posted anything here, so it seemed like time for a small update. I’ve been on a bit of a hiatus from working on new mathematical writing for a while now, so I’m afraid you’re unlikely to see a new article on here in the near future.
My tutoring practice is still going strong, though! If you think you might be interested, take a look at that page and shoot me an email. I’d be happy to talk.

Minimizer schemes
 
 
 Link to heading
 

Input: a window \(W\in \Sigma^{w+k-1}\)
Minimizer scheme: Sample the \(k\)-mer with the one with smallest hash:
\[f(W) = \mathrm{argmin}_{0\leq i\lt w\ \ } h(W_{i\dots i+k}).\]
Sampling scheme: Arbitrary function \(f: \Sigma^{w+k-1}\to \{0, \dots, w-1\}.\)
Density: The expected fraction of sampled \(k\)-mers in a random string:
E​A​DCAE.....
.​A​DCAEB....
..DC​A​EBE...
...C​A​EBEC..
....​A​EBECD.
.....E​B​ECDC
E​A​DC​A​E​B​ECDC
Kille et al. 2024

Conjecture: Optimal schemes exist for \(k\equiv 1\pmod w\)?
